summary: Iteration 7 - Announcements CRUD + rich fields (image/category/scope/pinned) fully tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed covering create with all fields, pinned-first sort, admin edit/delete, permission matrix (siswa cannot create, guru can create own only, guru 403 on others, admin overrides all, 404 on missing, upload endpoint). Frontend: verified Super Admin, Guru, and Siswa flows on /announcements against the public preview URL - create with image upload, pin badge, category badge, edit, delete, and role-based visibility of controls (pin checkbox only for admin; edit/delete only on cards where canManage).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now >1400 lines - should be split into routers per domain (auth, users, classes, announcements, uploads, reports, chats, events) for maintainability. Non-blocking.

Announcements image URLs are stored as absolute (BACKEND + /api/files/path) from the frontend; if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL changes in deployment, old announcements will keep the stale host. Consider storing only the relative /api/files/... path and letting the client prefix at render time.
GET /api/announcements returns all announcements regardless of scope; there is no filtering by kelas for scope=kelas. Non-blocking for this iteration but worth noting for privacy.
PATCH /api/announcements/{aid} accepts null-only body silently returning the doc unchanged - acceptable but could return 400 if upd is empty.
